citation: WhatsApp Inc. v. NSO Group Technologies Ltd., 17 F.4th 930 (9th Cir. 2021) (jurisdictional ruling); N.D. Cal. Case No. 4:19-cv-07123 (substantive §502/CFAA claims pending)
court: United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit (jurisdictional); Northern District of California (substantive)
statute_version_applicable: Cal. Penal Code §502(c)(1) and §502(c)(7) (current version) + 18 U.S.C. §1030 (CFAA)
rule_established: §502 and CFAA operate as parallel claims; exploitation of vulnerability to access computer systems = without permission; Cal. §502 applies when attacked systems are in California regardless of attacker location; parallel pleading of §502 + CFAA is standard in California federal cybercrime civil litigation
